concepts.styleSummary: Strong clean silhouette, confident outline, flat fills and minimal shading
concepts.description: Classic rubber duck in a bold friendly vector style with clean outlines, flat yellow and orange fills, minimal shading, balanced proportions, facing left in a 3/4 view.

observations.readability: Excellent silhouette definition at 32px and 64px due to bold dark outline and high contrast.
observations.svgEffort: Low to medium. Simple geometric curves, flat fills, minimal path count.
observations.accessoryFit: Generous room on top of head and neck for hats/collars.
observations.propSuitability: High; clean vector silhouette reads well against apartment compositions.

concepts.styleSummary: Strong clean silhouette, confident outline, flat fills and minimal shading
concepts.description: Bold friendly vector rubber duck with squat and wide body proportions, broad flat orange beak, dark round eye, warm yellow body, confident clean outlines, and minimal shading.

observations.readability: Very strong wide base; unmistakable duck silhouette even at 32px.
observations.accessoryFit: Broad head surface allows larger hat items without balance issues.
observations.propSuitability: Gives a stable, grounded tabletop toy impression.

concepts.styleSummary: Strong clean silhouette, confident outline, flat fills and minimal shading

concepts.styleSummary: Fuller volume, gentle limited gradients/highlights, smooth curves and restrained detail
concepts.description: Classic soft-rounded toy rubber duck with fuller volume, gentle smooth gradients and soft highlights, centered in a left-facing three-quarter view with warm yellow body, smooth orange bill, and dark round eye.

observations.readability: Soft edges reduce contrast slightly at 32px, but 3D volume reads convincingly at 64px+.

observations.accessoryFit: Smooth rounded head surface accommodates soft-edged accessories nicely.

concepts.styleSummary: Chunky shapes, decisive shadow planes, stronger contrast and angular accents
